list.name: color
list.label: Color
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_type FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_type IN ('WHITE', 'RED', 'BLUE') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_type FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_type IN ('WHITE', 'RED', 'BLUE') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

list.name: nfc
list.label: NFC
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${color:regex}' = '.*' OR workpiece_type ~ '${color:regex}') ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${color:regex}' = '.*' OR workpiece_type ~ '${color:regex}') ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, workpiece_id || ' · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(workpiece_type, ''), '?') AS metric, CASE WHEN topic LIKE 'fts/%' OR module_type = 'FTS' THEN 'FTS' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H73275' OR module_type = 'DPS' THEN 'DPS' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR3QA0022' OR module_type = 'HBW' THEN 'HBW' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H76449' OR module_type = 'DRILL' THEN 'DRILL' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR3QA2098' OR module_type = 'MILL' THEN 'MILL' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H76530' OR module_type IN ('AIQS', 'QUALITY') THEN 'AIQS' ELSE COALESCE(module_type, '—') END || ' / ' || action AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND action_state = 'FINISHED' AND (topic LIKE 'module/%' OR topic LIKE 'fts/%' OR (topic = 'ccu/order/completed' AND action IN ('MANUFACTURE', 'completed'))) AND workpiece_id ~ '${nfc:regex}' AND ('${color:regex}' = '.*' OR workpiece_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event s WHERE s.workpiece_type ~ '${color:regex}' AND s.workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND s.ts >= $__timeFrom() AND s.ts <= $__timeTo())) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 2000

SELECT ts, workpiece_id AS nfc, workpiece_type AS color, CASE WHEN topic LIKE 'fts/%' OR module_type = 'FTS' THEN 'FTS' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H73275' OR module_type = 'DPS' THEN 'DPS' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR3QA0022' OR module_type = 'HBW' THEN 'HBW' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H76449' OR module_type = 'DRILL' THEN 'DRILL' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR3QA2098' OR module_type = 'MILL' THEN 'MILL' WHEN module_serial = 'SVR4H76530' OR module_type IN ('AIQS', 'QUALITY') THEN 'AIQS' ELSE COALESCE(module_type, '—') END AS station, action, action_state, order_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND action_state = 'FINISHED' AND (topic LIKE 'module/%' OR topic LIKE 'fts/%' OR (topic = 'ccu/order/completed' AND action IN ('MANUFACTURE', 'completed'))) AND workpiece_id ~ '${nfc:regex}' AND ('${color:regex}' = '.*' OR workpiece_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event s WHERE s.workpiece_type ~ '${color:regex}' AND s.workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND s.ts >= $__timeFrom() AND s.ts <= $__timeTo())) ORDER BY ts, workpiece_id LIMIT 500
